evidence.note: Builds and runs i32.json as a baseline (2/459) before implementing, establishing a measurable signal rather than assuming.
Runs per-family MVP jsons in a loop, uses RUST_BACKTRACE on crashes, greps FAIL lines per file (block/func/select/conversions) and categorizes failures by type.
Runs full aggregate runner repeatedly (95.6% then 99.94%), then isolates the failing files to drive down the count — aggregate treated as a monitored signal, not a one-shot check.

Diagnoses semantic edge cases: decodes 0xC1E0 hex for a trunc boundary, finds an exec_load sign-extension bug, and uses od -tx1 to discover externref-table and unknown-function validation cases — distinguishing genuine bugs from encoding/validation mismatches.

Catches that the runall counter reported FAIL=0 while call_indirect actually panicked and truncated output; fixes the panic and engineers a stricter loop verifying every json emits a summary line — verification tooling itself is corrected.
Re-runs full suite after each fix to guard against regressions and pursues exact 34212/34212 = 1.0 rather than 'mostly passing', with final per-file sanity checks.

reasoning: The agent runs individual family jsons after each implementation step, reads specific FAIL @ line reasons, and fixes families before moving on (≥5), and also runs the aggregate runner repeatedly to guard MVP against SIMD regressions (≥8). It exceeds this by drilling into individual assertions to diagnose NaN/sign-extension/trunc-boundary/externref/alignment edge cases, separating real bugs from validation/encoding mismatches, treating the aggregate score as a monitored signal driven to exactly 1.0, and even correcting its own verification harness after discovering a panic was miscounted as zero failures — the full [10] behavior.
